title: Return Record and the Multiplier on Marlowe Rewards Points Reversals
content:
When Marlowe Rewards points are taken back on a refunded return, the multiplier applied to the reversed spend depends on the member's trailing return record.

## The return record

The record is read from the member's points ledger over the 12 months ending on the handling date. An entry dated exactly 12 months before the handling date does not count. It gives two figures:

- **Return share.** The reversed spend on reversal entries in those months, divided by the qualifying spend on earning entries in those months, as a percentage. It is zero when no qualifying spend was posted in those months.
- **Earning count.** The number of earning entries in those months.

## Multiplier applied

| Return share | Earning count | Multiplier applied to the reversal |
|---|---|---|
| under 10 percent | 6 or more | 1.00, so only base points are reversed |
| under 10 percent | 3 to 5 | the midpoint between 1.00 and the multiplier recorded on the order's original earning entry |
| from 10 percent to under 25 percent | 3 or more | the midpoint between 1.00 and the multiplier recorded on the order's original earning entry |
| any other record | any | the multiplier recorded on the order's original earning entry |

"Any other record" covers:

- a return share under 25 percent with an earning count of 2 or fewer; and
- a return share of 25 percent or more, whatever the earning count.

## The midpoint

The midpoint is 1.00 plus half of the difference between the recorded multiplier and 1.00. It is not rounded on its own. Hypothetical recorded multipliers:

| Recorded multiplier | Midpoint |
|---|---|
| 1.00 | 1.00 |
| 1.25 | 1.125 |
| 1.50 | 1.25 |
| 2.00 | 1.50 |
| 3.00 | 2.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical records)

| Return share | Earning count | Multiplier applied |
|---|---|---|
| 9.9 percent | 6 | 1.00 |
| 9.9 percent | 5 | midpoint |
| 10.0 percent | 6 | midpoint |
| 24.9 percent | 3 | midpoint |
| 25.0 percent | 9 | recorded multiplier |
| 0 percent (no qualifying spend posted) | 0 | recorded multiplier |

## The 12-month window

On a hypothetical handling date of 15 June 2025, entries dated 16 June 2024 through 15 June 2025 count, and an entry dated 15 June 2024 does not.
